map.库存计算器基于 EOQ 经济订货量模型计算最优订货量、安全库存与再订货点，结合年: The inventory calculator computes the optimal order quantity, safety stock and reorder point from the EOQ economic order quantity model, combining annual demand and service level; suited to inventory optimization in manufacturing and warehousing.
map.采购部门制定补货策略时，用 EOQ 平衡订货成本与持有成本，确定每次最优订货量。: When the purchasing department sets a replenishment strategy, it uses EOQ to balance ordering cost against holding cost and determine the optimal quantity per order.
map.面对需求波动与不确定提前期，用安全库存与再订货点 ROP 设定补货触发线，防止缺: Facing demand variability and uncertain lead times, use safety stock and the reorder point ROP to set the replenishment trigger line and prevent material shortages from stopping the line.
map.年度库存复盘时，用总库存成本（订货+持有）评估当前策略是否经济，优化订货频率。: At the annual inventory review, use total inventory cost (ordering + holding) to assess whether the current strategy is economical and to optimize order frequency.
map.：某零件年需求 12000 件、单次订货成本 50 元、年持有成本 2 元/件、: : A part has annual demand of 12000 units, ordering cost of 50 CNY per order, annual holding cost of 2 CNY per unit, daily demand of 33 units, lead time of 7 days, daily demand standard deviation of 5, and a service level of 95% (Z = 1.65). EOQ = sqrt(2x12000x50/2), about 775 units; orders per year = 12000/775, about 15.5 (cycle about 24 days); average inventory about 387 units; safety stock = 1.65x5xsqrt(7), about 22 units; reorder point ROP = 33x7 + 22, about 253 units; minimum total inventory cost about sqrt(2x12000x50x2), about 1549 CNY.
map.EOQ 越大越好还是越小越好？: Is a larger or a smaller EOQ better?
map.EOQ 是总成本最低点：订货量过大增加持有成本，过小增加订货频次与订货成本。EO: EOQ is the lowest point of total cost: too large an order quantity raises holding cost, too small raises order frequency and ordering cost. The EOQ formula sqrt(2DS/H) balances the two; in practice safety stock must also be added to absorb variability.
map.再订货点 ROP 怎么用？: How is the reorder point ROP used?
map.库存降到 ROP（日均需求×提前期 + 安全库存）时即触发订货，确保提前期内不断: When inventory falls to ROP (daily average demand x lead time + safety stock) an order is triggered, ensuring no material shortage during the lead time. The higher the service level (the larger Z is) and the greater the demand variability, the higher the safety stock and ROP.
